blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
We adapt Stevens’s power law to measure the innate ability of AI models to read visualizations, which can reveal the built-in perceptual mechanisms of algorithmic models. In our pilot study, models see no legend. A model first views a reference visual representation and estimates its magnitude, then estimates the magnitude of each subsequent image of the same representation relative to that reference.
Our evaluation of twelve visual variables makes how algorithmic models read visual encodings measurable, comparable with human perception, and more interpretable to humans. \href https://osf.io/wsrzm/overview?view_only=64b8d81b21344085954f78192ae0d19d osf.io/wsrzm has source code, images, magnitude data samples, and analyses.

我们对十二个视觉变量的评价使得算法模型如何读取视觉编码是可测量的,可以与人类的认知相比较的,更能对人类解释. 缩写(_R) https://osf.io/wsrzm/overview?view_ only=64b8d81b21344085954f78192ae0d19d (英语). osf.io/wsrzm有源代码,图像,等分数据样本,以及分析.

Figure 1 : A new psychophysical measurement of how neural network models respond to visual variables. We adapt Stevens’s measurement of humans’ subjective sense of physical stimulus intensity to measure how machines (GPT-5.5) respond to visual variables, e. g., length, area, color, and texture, and so on.
The α \alpha value describes how observers perceive magnitude changes as the intensity of a visual variable changes. The model’s response scaling is compressive when α < 1 \alpha<1 , linear when α = 1 \alpha=1 , and expansive when α > 1 \alpha>1 . α ^ \hat{\alpha} denotes the exponent for the model counterpart, and α \alpha for human observers where available. Observation. GPT-5.5’s responses scaled from linear to mildly compressive across visual variables. The three colormaps, Greys , plasma , and jet , had negative α \alpha , indicating that the model reversed the direction of the data values.

blocks.en: 1 Related Work
blocks.zh: 1 相关工作

blocks.en:
Understanding AI Model Behavior. Benchmark scores summarize model performance over a set of tasks. However, an aggregate score does not always show how model responses vary across tasks or input conditions.
Recent work argues that intelligence evaluation should measure behaviors and skill acquisition rather than only performance on a fixed task set [ 5 ] . ARC-AGI-2 extends this direction through fine-grained evaluation signals and human-tested tasks [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh:
理解AI模式行为. 基准分数总结了模型在一组任务上的表现. 然而,总分并不总是能显示模型响应如何因任务或输入条件而异.
最近的工作认为,情报评估应当衡量行为和技能的获得,而不只是在固定任务集上的表现[5]. ARC-AGI-2通过精细的评价信号和经人检验的任务来扩展这个方向[4].

blocks.en:
Jiang et al. proposed a data-domain sampling regime to assess CNN graphical perception in bar-chart ratio estimation [ 11 ] . Their analysis examined sensitivity to differences between training and test distributions, stability under limited samples, and performance relative to human observers. In this work, instead of directly measuring behaviors, we model behaviors via psychophysics laws:
we sample stimuli across controlled value ranges and analyze how the model’s numerical responses change with the variable. This lets us treat MLLMs as AI observers and model behaviors by their response functions, relative error, and how both vary across visual variables and compare against human observers.
Together, these studies motivate evaluations that systematically vary inputs and observe responses rather than relying only on aggregated benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
Jiang等提出了数据域抽样制度,以评估CNN在巴图比例估计中的图形感知[11]. 他们的分析研究了对培训和试验分布、有限样品下的稳定性和与人类观察员相比的性能之间的差异的敏感性。 在这部作品中,我们不是直接测量行为,而是通过心理物理学定律来模拟行为:
并分析模型的数值反应如何随变量变化。 这让我们将MLLMs作为AI观察者和模型行为按其反应功能,相对错误,以及两者如何因视觉变量而异并与人类观察者作比较.
这些研究加在一起,促使评价系统改变投入和观察答复,而不是只依靠综合基准。

blocks.en:
A Brief Review of Stevens’s Power Law. Stevens invented a psychophysics method to test how observers scale input stimulus [ 20 , 21 , 19 ] . Standard stimulus has a ground truth reference value (for example, calling a tone of a given loudness “100”), and an human observer assigned it a value (say calling the same loudness “120”). Observers then assigned numbers to other stimulus intensities in proportion to their own standard.
In this way, because observers respond across the whole stimulus range, the procedure measures the global relationship between physical intensity and perceived magnitude. Stevens discovered this relationship as a power function, which is fit separately for each visual variable: ψ ⁡ ( I ) = k ​ I α , \psi(I)=kI^{\alpha}, where I I is the ground-truth stimulus intensity, ψ \psi is the observer (humans in Stevens and model in ours)’s response, k k is a proportionality constant, and α \alpha , is the power-law exponent, which is arguably the most important parameter because it describes how the observer’s response scales with stimulus intensity.
Taking the logarithm of both sides gives ln ⁡ ( ψ ⁡ ( I ) ) = ln ⁡ k + α ​ ln ​ I , \ln\!\bigl(\psi(I)\bigr)=\ln k+\alpha\ln I, so estimating α \alpha as the slope of a linear regression in log-log space indicates compressive scaling when α < 1 \alpha<1 , linear scaling when α = 1 \alpha=1 , and expansive scaling when α > 1 \alpha>1 . Stevens measured many perceptual continua and found that exponents differ widely across them. For example, perceived line length is roughly linear, while the discomfort of electric shock is strongly expansive ( α ≈ 3.5 \alpha\approx 3.5 ).

blocks.en:
Weber’s law has been used to measure just noticeable differences (JNDs), the smallest change in a stimulus that observers can reliably detect in visualizations [ 8 , 16 , 15 ] .
That approach and ours are complementary, since
Weber’s law quantifies discrimination, whereas Stevens’s law quantifies the form of the perceptual scale. We use Stevens’s law because our question is not whether a model can distinguish two close values, but how its estimates of magnitude compress or expand across the range of each visual variable.

blocks.en: 3.4 GPT-5.5’s implicit numerical mapping of colormaps
blocks.zh: 3.4 GPT-5.5所隐含的颜色图数字映射

blocks.en:
We suspected that GPT-5.5 using a colormap direction opposite to the numerical direction used to produce the input images since the α \alpha values were negative for the last three color maps.
To further investigate this behavior, we conducted a follow-up full-sampling experiment to examine GPT-5.5’s implicit numerical mapping of the colormaps.
For each colormap, we selected the 50th sampled color as the reference stimulus and asked GPT-5.5 to assign it a number to color value. We then presented all remaining sampled colors as targets within the same conversation and asked the model to estimate their values relative to the reference. \autoref fig:MLLM_jet_order shows the resulting numerical mappings across the full colormap.
Without giving a legend and colormap name, GPT-5.5 read colors as hue angle (jet: 0–240; plasma: two clusters split by the 360° wrap-around) or gray level (Greys: 0–255) rather than colormap position. This reverses the stimulus direction for jet and Greys; for plasma it yields a negative fit despite preserved hue order.
blocks.zh:
我们怀疑GPT-5.5使用与用于制作输入图像的数值方向相反的色图方向,因为α-α值对后三幅色图来说是负的.
为了进一步调查这种行为,我们进行了一个后续的全采样实验,以检查GPT-5.5对色图的隐含数字映射.
对于每个彩色图,我们选择了第50个被采样的颜色作为参考刺激,并要求GPT-5.5为颜色值指定一个数字. 然后,我们在同一次谈话中将所有剩下的被取样的颜色作为目标,并要求模型估计它们相对于参考物的数值。 \autoref fig: MLLM_jet_order 显示整个色彩图中产生的数值映射.
在不给出"传说"和"彩相图"名称的情况下,GPT-5.5将颜色读取为hue角度(喷射:0–240;等离子体:由360°相环相接而分出两个星团)或灰相位(Greys:0–255),而不是彩相图位置. 这扭转了喷气式和灰相的刺激方向;对等离子体来说,尽管保留了发光顺序,它仍产生负相。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Measuring MLLMs as AI observers. Treating an MLLM as an observer gives us an
operational way to analyze its measurable responses to controlled psychophysics study methods
without assuming model’s innate perception of visual variables. The move follows proposal that
visualization serves as a stimulus domain for vision science: the response
function and innate maps can be discovered, to be connected to the accuracy score of a broader image stimuli in image-based evaluations [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh:
以AI观察者身份测量 MLLMs. 将MLLM作为观察员对待,给我们带来了
分析其对受控心理物理研究方法的可衡量反应的实用方法
而不是假设模型对视觉变量的内在感知。 这一行动是根据以下提议进行的:
视觉是视觉科学的刺激领域:对策
可发现函数和内生图,与图像评价中更广泛的图像刺激的准确分数相连接[2]。

blocks.en: Models perceive brighter is higher in colormaps. People often expect darker colors to represent larger quantities in data visualizations [ 17 ] , a tendency known as the dark-is-more bias. Our initial results showed the opposite pattern in GPT-5.5: the model tended to assign higher values to lighter colors, a lighter-is-higher bias. One possible reason is that lighter colors have higher luminance values in color space, for example white has the highest luminance.
blocks.zh: 模型感知出更亮的颜色图更高. 人们常常期望更暗的颜色在数据可视化中代表出更大的量 [17],这一趋势被称作"更暗的偏差". 我们的初步结果在GPT-5.5中显示出了相反的规律:模型倾向于给更浅的颜色分配更高的值,一个更轻的比高的偏差. 一个可能的原因是更轻的颜色在颜色空间中具有更高的发光值,例如白的发光率最高.

blocks.en:
Limitations. The current analysis focuses on one model, GPT-5.5. The study uses controlled synthetic stimuli, which do not cover the complexity of real-world visualization images. The pilot experiment also includes a small subset of the possible reference-target combinations, leaving fewer observations for some spans and reference bins.
Future work should test additional MLLMs, more complete variable combinations, real-world visualization tasks, and different prompt conditions. Comparing stimuli with and without legends may also show how much the model relies on visual information, explicit labels, or learned semantic knowledge.
blocks.zh:
限制。 目前的分析侧重于一种模型,即GPT-5.5. 该研究采用了可控合成刺激,并不涵盖现实世界可视化图像的复杂性. 试点实验还包括一个小子集可能的参考-目标组合,留下一些跨度和参考箱的观测较少.
今后的工作应当测试额外的MLLM,更完整的可变组合,现实世界可视化任务,以及不同的即时条件. 将刺激与和没有传说作比较,也可以显示模型在多大程度上依赖于视觉信息,明确的标签,或所学的语义知识.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Our new evaluation method reveals fundamental insights into the next steps of
interpreting MLLMs:
If a model can report the magnitude of an encoding
named only in text, with no legend in the image to match against, then it
carries a built-in sensory system that we can measure directly rather than infer
from task performance.
Our extension of Stevens’s power law to model measurements shows that the innate colormaps shows opposite to the one used to generate the visualization images. This result also support that having language alone might not be enough and visual information is necessary.
We therefore see that psychophysics experiment can be transparent about machine’s problem solving gaps and emphasizes importance of having explicit context display such as legend may be just as important for proper machine perception.
blocks.zh:
我们的新评价方法揭示了对今后步骤的基本见解。

携带内置感官系统 我们可以直接测量 而不是推断
从任务执行。
我们把史蒂文斯的动力定律扩展为模型测量法,表明内生的色彩图显示的与用来生成可视化图像的颜色图相反. 这一结果还证明,单凭语言可能是不够的,而视觉信息是必要的。
因此,我们看到,心理物理学实验可以透明地说明机器解决漏洞的问题,并强调明确上下文(如传说)的重要性,对于正确的机器感知可能同样重要。
